scope: Curated public imagery and actual assisted gameplay clips with preserved pixels/timing. Concepts and references are copied byte-for-byte; internal game stills are losslessly PNG-compressed. Status distinguishes captures, concepts and material references. Sanitized source identifiers are not public download paths.
capture_comparison: Stock and remaster captures are not frame-aligned. Render resolution is not original asset resolution or an FPS guarantee.
